description: NBA player-game and team-game performance analytics: trajectories, streaks, matchups, fatigue. v1 covers basketball player-game grain only. v2 will add baseball + soccer subdomains.

expected_relationships.rationale: home/away, rest, opponent strength affect performance distributions
rolling minutes + back-to-backs predict near-term decline
opponent defensive metrics gate scoring efficiency

characteristic_patterns.name: Performance trajectory
characteristic_patterns.signature: directional drift in rolling mean across season

characteristic_patterns.name: Hot / cold streak
characteristic_patterns.signature: sustained run above/below player's rolling mean

characteristic_patterns.name: Fatigue accumulation
characteristic_patterns.signature: performance decay correlated with minutes / back-to-backs

characteristic_patterns.name: Matchup-dependent performance
characteristic_patterns.signature: between-opponent performance variance significantly above noise

characteristic_patterns.name: Regression to mean
characteristic_patterns.signature: extreme early-season values revert toward season mean
characteristic_patterns.detection_rule: early-season z > 1.5 followed by drift toward season mean

characteristic_patterns.name: Home-court edge
characteristic_patterns.signature: performance gap home vs away exceeds league baseline

action_library.label: Predict performance trajectory
action_library.description: AR + matchup-adjusted forecast for the next N games. Surface trajectory with explicit CI.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: AR + matchup model captures ~55% of variance at 5-game horizon.
falsification: forecast CI brackets actual < 70% of the time
assumptions: no injury / role change in window

action_library.label: Identify fatigue risk
action_library.description: Surface players whose rolling minutes + back-to-backs predict near-term performance decline. Useful for rest-day decisions.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: When the fatigue rule fires, ~65% of next-game performances are below player's rolling mean.
falsification: fatigue-flagged player exceeds rolling mean in next game
assumptions: minutes data is accurate and complete

action_library.label: Project matchup outcome
action_library.description: Use historical opponent-conditional performance + opponent defensive metrics to project next matchup.
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Matchup-conditional projection exceeds naive mean by ~12% reduced MAE in cross-validation.
assumptions: sufficient prior history vs that opponent (≥ 3 games)

action_library.label: Flag unusual performance pattern
action_library.description: Surface games where performance is > 2σ from player's expected, with context drivers (rest, opponent, venue).
action_library.predicted_outcome_summary: Outlier games attributable to context (rest, matchup) ~60% of the time; pure noise ~40%.
